title: Reported Arrival Of Japanese Women Farmers

page_data.en:
FORM NO. 3
G. 40M-1 36

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S. I. Special Branch Station;
No. S. D. D.
Date November 17, 19 3 .
File No.

REPORT

Subject (in full) Reported arrival of Japanese women farmers.

Made by D. K. Kamashita Forwarded by

With reference to the attached cutting from the
North China Daily News dated November 16, 193 , regarding
the above subject, I have to state that the information
contained therein is not correct. Mrs. Kuro Fukushima,
aged 56, arrived here from Nagasaki aboard the
Maru on November 14, in company with four Japanese
women, one of whom is her daughter while the others are
employees brought here by her for the purpose of working
in her entertainment house. Mrs. Kuro Fukushima resides
at No. 27 Mei-mei Lee (美帽里 ) off North Szechuen Road,
where she operates an entertainment house for Japanese
sailors.

D. K. Kamashita

FILE

D. C. (Special Branch).
P. A. to D. C. (Sp. Br.)

报告

事由（全称） 关于日本女农抵达的报告。

呈报人 D. K. Kamashita 转呈人

关于随附的 193 年 11 月 16 日《字林西报》剪报，涉及上述事由，本人须声明，其中所载信息并不正确。黑福岛（Kuro Fukushima）夫人，56 岁，于 11 月 14 日乘“丸”号轮船从长崎抵达此处，同行者有四名日本妇女，其中一人为其女儿，其余几人为她带来在其娱乐场工作的雇员。黑福岛夫人居住于北四川路旁美帽里 27 号，在那里她经营一家面向日本水手的娱乐场。

D. K. Kamashita

存档

副总监（特别支部）。
助理致副总监（特别支部）。

page_data.en:
NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS,

NOV 16 1938

Japanese Women Farmers
For Central China
Group Arrives to Take Up
Agriculture Here

Determined to become women
farmers in Central China, nine Japan-
ese women, led by Mrs. Muro Fuku-
shima, arrived in Shanghai on Mon-
day in the ss. Shanghai Maru. They
brought their own agricultural im-
plements.
Also aboard the vessel was Lieut.-
Gen. Bunshiro Tanabe, retired,
director of the Dojinkai Hospitals,
who will visit the various clinics
operated by the Society in Central
China. Dojinkai units are active in
Shanghai, Nanking, and Hangchow.
Passengers included 94 in the first
class and 273 in third-class.
page_data.zh:
《字林西报》，

1938 年 11 月 16 日

日本女农
前往华中
一行抵沪从事
农业活动

决心成为华中地区的女农，九名日本妇女在室福岛（Muro Fukushima，音译）夫人的带领下，于星期一乘“上海丸”号轮船抵达上海。她们自带了农具。
同船抵达的还有退役中将田边文四郎（Bunshiro Tanabe），同善会医院院长，他将视察该会在华中地区运营的各诊所。同善会的分支机构在上海、南京和杭州开展活动。
乘客包括头等舱 94 人，三等舱 273 人。
